name: Flame core
description: A single volumetric flame raymarched through a noise-eroded sphere, glowing from the inside out. Where the 2D fire effect gives a wall of flame, this gives one body of it with depth.

speed.description: How fast the flame licks upward.

turbulence.description: How hard the noise erodes the flame body. Low is a smooth teardrop, high is torn and ragged.

glow.description: Accumulated glow gain. Drives how far the flame's light reaches into the dark.

tint.description: Blend toward the project palette. 0 keeps the native orange-to-blue gradient.
